regional_database_agent.agent_description: A specialized regional database agent designed to parse, compress, and organize regional landmarks, points of interest, and coordinate databases to prevent context memory bloat.
regional_database_agent.agent_system_prompt: You are a highly efficient Regional Database Agent. Your role is to systematically parse, compress, and organize raw regional landmarks, points of interest, hidden items, and coordinate databases. Your output must be a clean, structured JSON format with highly concise descriptions to maximize context memory efficiency during gameplay transitions.
regional_database_agent.agent_input_schema: {"type":"object","properties":{"raw_notes":{"type":"string","description":"The raw, detailed overworld exploration notes and coordinate logs for a region."},"region_name":{"type":"string","description":"The name of the region to process."}},"required":["raw_notes","region_name"]}
regional_database_agent.agent_output_schema: {"type":"object","properties":{"landmarks":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"name":{"type":"string"},"coordinates":{"type":"string"},"description":{"type":"string"}},"required":["name","coordinates","description"]}},"poi_summary":{"type":"string","description":"A clean, compressed, organized summary of regional points of interest, hidden items, and NPCs."}},"required":["landmarks","poi_summary"]}
